args.title: Public mail counters cannot distinguish normal skips or unclassified sources from an observation gap
args.detail: Observed 2026-11-07: the last private cycle had processed 0 and skipped 5, and commercial feedback had 3 unclassified sources and 2 excluded sources. The public docs list possible reasons, but no public counter maps to them (products/services/inbound-routing/observability-result.json). Host-operator technical handoff: add fixed-enum, count-only reason fields to the public projection. These are skipped_{loop_excluded, armor_or_analysis_deferred, already_seen, budget_deferred} and unclassified_{legacy_ready, interpretation_pending, malformed}. They would carry no ids, addresses or bodies, which AGENTMAIL.md:35 permits. Optionally, the operator could also attest the AGENTMAIL.md:42 real benign-mail test. Agents cannot change host code. Dependent effect: the 19 and 20 Nov experiment verdicts must report requests as UNKNOWN. Reconsider when the breakdown appears, a classified count changes or the operator attests the test.
args.expected_gain: Lets the live experiments tell 'no inbound requests' apart from 'requests not observed'. No demand or revenue is implied.
